selected publications.name: Unsteady Loads of a Scaled Rotor on and near the Landing Deck of the NATO Generic Destroyer with Concurrent Stereo PIV and Surface Pressure Measurements
selected publications.publisher: Journal of the American Helicopter Society
selected publications.summary: An experimental investigation to gain a general understanding of the interactional aerodynamics between the NATO Generic Destroyer and a representative single main rotor, operating both stationary and dynamically moving in the vicinity of the landing deck.

selected publications.name: Aerodynamic Characteristics of a Standard Dynamics Model in a Spinning Motion
selected publications.publisher: Journal of Aeronautics, Astronautics and Aviation
selected publications.summary: The rotary balance was developed at the Aerospace Science and Technology Research Center (ASTRC) of National Chung Kung University. The aerodynamic characteristics of a standard dynamics model (SDM) were compared with results from other wind tunnel tests and showed good agreement.

selected publications.name: Aerodynamic effects on an emulated hovering passerine with different wing-folding amplitudes
selected publications.summary: A novel multiarticulate flapping-wing robot with five degrees of freedom on each wing was designed to investigate the aerodynamic effects of wing-folding amplitude during hovering flight.
